meta.name: listing-distribution
meta.description: Gets a product listed where buyers and crawlers look — directories, marketplaces, review sites, comparison pages, and aggregators. Use this to plan a submission push, choose which directories are worth the effort, prepare listing assets, build comparison and alternative pages, or manage presence on review platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品送进买家会逛的目录和比价页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有产品想在更多平台被看到,却不知从哪个目录开始
copy.tagline_en: Get your product listed on directories, marketplaces, and review sites
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product needing exposure across directories and comparison sites.

howto.what: Claude 会按这套方法帮你规划产品列表分发：筛选买家会看的目录/评论站，整理一份含不同长度简介、图片、分类、价格等的可复用资料包，并指导你回复评论、写诚实的对比与替代页。
howto.when: 当你说要规划一次产品提交、筛选值得投的目录或评论站，或准备提交素材时。

say.text: 帮我想想这款产品投哪些目录/评论站值得，哪些该跳过。
say.note: 它会按买家是否使用这些站来筛选。

say.text: 帮我备一套可复用的提交资料：几种长度的简介、图片、分类和价格。
say.note: 它会按方法整理成一份可复用资料包。

say.text: 帮我草拟一条差评回复：不辩解，针对问题具体回应。
say.note: 它会草拟具体且不带防御姿态的回复。

howto.what_en: Claude plans listing distribution: picks valuable directories/review sites, assembles a reusable kit (descriptions, images, categories, pricing), and guides review replies and honest comparison/alternative pages.
howto.when_en: Use it when you plan a submission push, choose worthwhile directories/review sites, or prepare listing assets.

say_en.text: Which directories/review sites are worth submitting to, and which to skip?
say_en.note: Claude checks whether real buyers use the site.

say_en.text: Prepare reusable kit: short/long descriptions, images, categories, pricing.
say_en.note: Claude compiles the kit for you.

say_en.text: Draft a reply to this negative review — specific, not defensive.
say_en.note: Claude gives a concrete, non-defensive response.
